citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
Routine calibration of mechanical equipment is not performed according to a written program designed to assure proper performance.
Procedures describing the warehousing of drug products are not established.
The written stability testing program is not followed.

citations.short: Annual visual exams of drug products
citations.long: Reserve samples from representative sample lots or batches of drug products selected by acceptable statistical procedures are not examined visually at least once a year for evidence of deterioration.
There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
Drug products that have been subjected to improper storage conditions  were salvaged and returned to the marketplace without further evidence or inspection.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

citations.short: Buildings of Suitable Size, Construction, Location
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product do not have the suitable construction to facilitate cleaning, maintenance, and proper operations.

citations.short: Adequate space lacking  to prevent mix-ups and contamination
citations.long: The building lacks adequate space for the orderly placement of equipment and materials to prevent mix-ups between different components, in-process materials, and drug products and to prevent contamination.

citations.short: Air filtration system lacking in production area
citations.long: The production area air supply lacks an appropriate air filtration system.

citations.short: Buildings not maintained in good state of repair
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacturing, processing, packing, and holding of a drug product are not maintained in a good state of repair.
Procedures describing the warehousing of drug products are not established.
Drug products are not stored under appropriate conditions of temperature so that their identity, strength, quality, and purity are not affected.
